name: PEP (PCN pre-registration exam)
audience: Nigerian pharmacy graduates preparing for the Pharmacists Council of Nigeria (PCN) pre-registration exam (PEP)
standard: PEP licensing-exam standard: what a newly qualified pharmacist in Nigeria must know and apply in practice

courses.PRAC: Pharmacy Practice, Dispensing and Pharmaceutical Care
courses.MGT: Pharmacy Management, Supply Chain and Drug Policy

examples.q: A 62-year-old man with asthma needs a beta blocker for angina. Which is the most appropriate choice?
examples.e: Bisoprolol is cardioselective (beta-1); the others are non-selective and can cause bronchospasm.
